name: footage-skills
description: Turn real recorded footage — a phone take, a webcam recording, a screen capture — into a finished vertical short: cut silences and filler words from the take, word-synced karaoke captions, graphic overlays and a picture-in-picture moment where a graphic owns the frame, and a music bed mixed by measurement instead of by feel. Carries the corpus of failures that produce no error at all: audio elements that render silent, panels that animate perfectly while invisible, captions drawn on top of each other, beds louder than the speaker, and volumes clamped without a warning. Not for videos built from AI-generated imagery.
